sloka: श्रीश्च धर्मश्च काकुत्स्थ त्वयि नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितौ ।एताश्चान्याश्च मधुरा वन्दिभिः परिकीर्तिताः ।। ७.३७.९ ॥
transliteration: śrīśca dharmaśca kākutstha tvayi nityaṁ pratiṣṭhitau ।etāścānyāśca madhurā vandibhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ ।। 7.37.9 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, prosperity and righteousness are eternally established in you, and these and other sweet praises were sung by the bards.
